AgentList.description: Answer of ``GET /api/agents``. ``ran`` adds up to the Cost tile.
AgentList.title: AgentList

AgentMoney.description:
One agent's part of the range's cost. ``agent`` is an agent key.

The rows add up to the Cost tile, so a plugin agent with no file still has one.
AgentMoney.title: AgentMoney

AgentNoRuns.description: An agent file with no run in the range.
AgentNoRuns.title: AgentNoRuns

AgentRow.description:
An agent that ran in the range, with its setup and its model check status.

``set_reason`` says why ``set`` holds no value. ``ran_pairs`` lists every pair
the runs used, most runs first. ``runs_as_set`` and ``runs_not_as_set`` come
from the model check and are None when nothing is set.
AgentRow.title: AgentRow

BackupFailure.description: A daily backup that did not finish. A later good copy clears it.
BackupFailure.title: BackupFailure

CardError.description: A card the server could not build. Its field in the answer is None.
CardError.title: CardError

ChartBar.description:
One bar of the cost chart.

``start`` and ``end`` are clipped to the chart window and to T, so the first and
last bars may be shorter than one ``unit``. ``open`` marks the bar that holds T.
``holds_oldest`` marks the bar that holds ``window.oldest``. ``no_records`` marks
a bar that ends before ``oldest``, which the page shows as no records, not $0.
ChartBar.title: ChartBar

ChartWindow.description:
The chart's own window, and why a pager end is reached.

On the newest page the window is the range's window, so the legend total equals
the Cost tile. Earlier pages are whole windows of the same length. ``all`` is one
page from ``oldest`` to T, with both ends reached, in days, weeks or months by span.
ChartWindow.title: ChartWindow

ClockInfo.description: Which clock the server answers with. ``rate_n`` is set only for ``rate``.
ClockInfo.title: ClockInfo

CostChart.description: Answer of ``GET /api/cost-chart``. It never changes the tiles.
CostChart.title: CostChart

CostTile.description: The cost tile, with the unpriced requests of the range and of the prior.
CostTile.title: CostTile

CountTile.description:
A whole-number tile. ``change_pct`` is relative, ``change_abs`` the difference.

Both changes are None when there is no prior window or ``window.prior_partial``.
``change_pct`` is also None when the prior value is 0.
CountTile.title: CountTile

CrossCheck.description: Result of comparing the active table with a second public list.
CrossCheck.title: CrossCheck

Cum.description: Cumulative values at the end of one bucket.
Cum.title: Cum

EndedSession.description: The newest session in a project that is no longer running.
EndedSession.title: EndedSession

ErrorEnvelope.description: The one error body. It never carries input or file paths.
ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope

HistoryInfo.description: What the store holds and how well it is kept.
HistoryInfo.title: HistoryInfo

Ingest.description: Progress of the first read of the usage history.
Ingest.title: Ingest

IngestError.description: Why a first-run ingest failed. ``file`` is None when the contract names none.
IngestError.title: IngestError

KindCosts.description: Dollars per kind of cost, over priced requests only.
KindCosts.title: KindCosts

LatestRequest.description: One of the eight newest requests at or before T.
LatestRequest.title: LatestRequest

LiveSession.description: A running session in the Session Select.
LiveSession.title: LiveSession

LiveSessionsUnchanged.description: The short session-list answer when the asked etag still matches.
LiveSessionsUnchanged.title: LiveSessionsUnchanged

ModelBarCost.description: One model's part of a chart bar. ``cost`` is None when none of it is priced.
ModelBarCost.title: ModelBarCost

ModelCheck.description: Every agent's model check, plus how many are in effect.
ModelCheck.title: ModelCheck

ModelCheckRow.description: The model check for one agent type in the session.
ModelCheckRow.title: ModelCheckRow

ModelCost.description: A legend entry over the chart window. A model with no price keeps its entry.
ModelCost.title: ModelCost

ModelKinds.description: One model's dollars per kind of cost, over its priced requests.
ModelKinds.title: ModelKinds

ModelList.description: Answer of ``GET /api/models``. ``unpriced`` covers the whole legend.
ModelList.title: ModelList

ModelPrice.description: One model's rates in USD per million tokens.
ModelPrice.title: ModelPrice

ModelRow.description: One model over the range. ``used_by`` holds agent keys.
ModelRow.title: ModelRow

ModelTokens.description: A legend entry, new tokens over the axis.
ModelTokens.title: ModelTokens

PairRuns.description: One model and effort pair the runs used, with its run count.
PairRuns.title: PairRuns

PassError.description: A whole-pass failure after the first ingest. The next good pass clears it.
PassError.title: PassError

PriceTier.description: Rates that apply once a prompt passes a size, in USD per million tokens.
PriceTier.title: PriceTier

RanPair.description: What the runs used, most common first. ``mixed`` when runs differ.
RanPair.title: RanPair

ReviewSession.description:
One session in a Review list. ``agents`` are agent keys, biggest cost first.

``tokens``, ``cost`` and ``runs`` count the range only. ``started_before_range``
marks a session whose first request is before ``window.start``, and ``whole``
then holds its numbers over its whole life, so the page can show either.
ReviewSession.title: ReviewSession

ReviewWindow.description:
The range's window and the one it compares with, in the answer's zone.

``end`` is the clock T. ``prior_start`` and ``prior_end`` are None for ``all``.
``oldest`` is the oldest stored request in the project, or None when there is
none. ``partial`` is True when ``oldest`` falls after ``start``, so the range
holds less history than its name. ``prior_partial`` is True when ``oldest`` falls
after ``prior_start``, so a change against the prior would mislead.
ReviewWindow.title: ReviewWindow

Round.description: One round of a run. ``by`` is ``main``, a run id, or None.
Round.title: Round

RunningItem.description: One session that is running now.
RunningItem.title: RunningItem

Segment.description: A drawn stretch of a lane, one per round.
Segment.title: Segment

SessionDay.description:
The sessions of one local day.

A session sits under the local day of its first request inside the range, so a
session that started before the range sits under the range's first day. A day
can continue on the next page, and the page joins it under one header. The field
is ``day``, not ``date``, because a field named like its type breaks the
annotation in a Pydantic class body.
SessionDay.title: SessionDay

SessionList.description:
Answer of ``GET /api/sessions``.

Newest first by (first request in range, id). ``next`` is an opaque cursor that
anchors on the last row's sort key, so a refetch never repeats or moves loaded
rows, and None at the end of the list.
SessionList.title: SessionList

SessionWhole.description: A session's whole numbers, for a session that started before the range.
SessionWhole.title: SessionWhole

SetPair.description: The model and effort an agent's setup asks for.
SetPair.title: SetPair

SetValue.description: What a file or setting sets, with its display path and line.
SetValue.title: SetValue

ShareTile.description: A share from 0 to 1, such as the cache share. ``change_abs`` is in shares.
ShareTile.title: ShareTile

StateAt.description: A state that starts at ``at`` and holds until the next entry.
StateAt.title: StateAt

Summary.description: Answer of ``GET /api/summary``. ``model_check`` is None when its card failed.
Summary.title: Summary

SwapResponse.description: Keys handed out after a code swap.
SwapResponse.title: SwapResponse

TimelineAxis.description: The x axis over the whole session, and the y ticks for new tokens.
TimelineAxis.title: TimelineAxis

TimelineBucket.description: One bar. ``by_model`` holds new tokens and leaves out models with none.
TimelineBucket.title: TimelineBucket

TimelinePrices.description: The price facts a cost label needs.
TimelinePrices.title: TimelinePrices

TimelineRun.description: One agent run, or the main session (``agent`` None, ``parent`` None).
TimelineRun.title: TimelineRun

Together.description: Siblings launched within 5 s of each other share a key.
Together.title: Together

Unchanged.description: The short answer when the asked etag still matches.
Unchanged.title: Unchanged

Unpriced.description: Requests with no price, and the models they ran on, in catalog order.
Unpriced.title: Unpriced

Window.description: Numbers over a stretch of time, such as the 60 s before T.
Window.title: Window
